extraquests.key_value.title: %s: %s
extraquests.key_value.ignore.tooltip: Ignore quest requirements and task order? The repeat cooldown still applies.
extraquests.reward.command.console.toolt: Execute a command from the console
extraquests.calendar.timezone.tooltip: An IANA time zone, for example UTC, Europe/Berlin. Invalid input falls back to UTC.
extraquests.calendar.pool.tooltip: Optional rotation pool name. Quests with matching pools and schedules rotate together. Leave empty to make this quest available every period.
extraquests.calendar.active_quests.toolt: Selection is stable for each team and period, including restarts. If pool sizes differ, the smallest configured value is used.
extraquests.attribute.operation.tooltip: For fractions, 0.1 gives a 10% bonus. Add value uses the attribute’s own units.
extraquests.attribute.stacking.tooltip: The maximum applies to this reward. Claiming again refreshes the duration of its entire bonus.
extraquests.attribute.duration.tooltip: Real time, including offline time. Survives server restarts and player death.
extraquests.streak.every.tooltip: Enable Calendar schedule in this quest's settings. A pool streak advances once per period when any selected quest in that pool is completed.
extraquests.options.shared.tooltip: Shares this task across all FTB teams. Enable to edit the settings below. Turning it off keeps the selected aggregation and personal minimum.
extraquests.options.aggregation.tooltip: Auto sums action increments and statistics, and takes the best inventory/state sample. Sum adds personal high-water samples; Best keeps the largest personal result.
extraquests.options.minimum.tooltip: Required for every reward in this quest. Zero allows everyone. Disable Per-Team Reward to reward each qualified player separately. Completed tasks accept no further contributions.
extraquests.options.duration.tooltip: Used while Timed challenge is enabled. Real time continues while offline or the server is stopped. Consumed resources are not refunded. Statistics count gains from the attempt baseline.
extraquests.options.timer_start.tooltip: First progress starts with a positive contribution. When available starts while an online team can attempt the task; useful for single-step goals such as advancements.
extraquests.options.shared_tooltip: Progress is shared across the server
extraquests.challenge.reset_death.toolti: With Server-wide objective disabled, any FTB team member's death resets that team's attempt. With it enabled, the death of a player who started or contributed to the attempt resets it for all teams. Only applies while the timer is running and the task is unfinished.
extraquests.challenge.reset_damage.toolt: With Server-wide objective disabled, damage received by any FTB team member resets that team's attempt. With it enabled, damage to a player who started or contributed to the attempt resets it for all teams. Only applies while the timer is running and the task is unfinished.
extraquests.challenge.reset_logout.toolt: With Server-wide objective disabled, any FTB team member leaving the server resets that team's attempt. With it enabled, a player who started or contributed to the attempt leaving the server resets it for all teams. Only applies while the timer is running and the task is unfinished.
extraquests.shared.locked_team: Unlock teams with progress in this quest before resetting the server-wide goal.
extraquests.shared.reset: Shared task %s, contributions and quest claims have been reset.
extraquests.options.timer_enabled.toolti: Enable to use the time limit and failure conditions below. Turning it off keeps the selected duration and other settings.
extraquests.calendar.enabled.tooltip: Makes this entire quest daily or weekly. At each boundary, all its objectives and reward claims reset. Previously earned items remain with players; unclaimed rewards from the old period expire.
extraquests.calendar.weekly.tooltip: Off: reset every day. On: reset every week on the selected weekday. Uses real time and the configured time zone.
extraquests.player_nbt.nbt.tooltip: Choose a common field from a searchable list or enter NBT manually, including mod data. Field values are compared for equality every 3 seconds (60 ticks); extra fields are allowed unless full exact matching is enabled. An empty filter never completes the objective.
extraquests.player_nbt.exact_match.toolt: When enabled, the filter must equal the entire saved player NBT. When disabled, only the specified fields must match; additional fields are allowed and each specified list element must be present. An empty list requires an empty list.
extraquests.player_nbt.manual.tooltip: Edit arbitrary NBT, including nested fields and mod data. You can also remove fields here.
extraquests.player_nbt.field.tooltip: Set this field without changing the others. All fields in the filter must match. Save the task settings to apply your changes.
extraquests.player_nbt.configured: Included in the filter. Required value: %s
extraquests.player_nbt.not_configured: Not included in the filter. Choose this field to add a condition.
